items.title: #Magic center Goga Bitadze got in foul trouble Monday but still recorded 11 points, 5 rebounds, 2 steals and 2 blocks in 27 mins. to help Georgia win, 98-90, at Portugal.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic center Goga Bitadze got in foul trouble Monday but still recorded 11 points, 5 rebounds, 2 steals and 2 blocks in 27 mins. to help Georgia win, 98-90, at Portugal.

Georgia went 2-0 in the fourth qualifying window in hopes of reaching the FIBA World Cup 2027 in Qatar.
